messages.subject: Varying loading time
parts:
My app (dodxtx.com) sometimes shows up "please wait ... screen" for up to 10 seconds, sometimes loads immediately, both on Iphone and mozilla / ie browsers, sometimes, loading times vary even seconds apart - even though the overall trafic is negligable -  i.e.I may have zero users , or 1, i try to go to website on my iphone and I have to wait 10 seconds looking on a please wait screen I have basic plan. Sometimes on the other hand its instant.

The application doesnt do any calculations on loading. It does however read a 40kb file.
Any ideas why app loading time varies ?
Any ideas what I should do (chance in advance setting regarding the workers / instances / tresholds) do minimize loading time ?
For now i have:

Max Worker Processes  10
Max Connections 1
Worker Load Factor 15%
Connection Timeout 450 sec
Read Timeout 120 sec
Startup Timeout 60 sec
Idle Timeout 30
Instance Load Factor 66%
Start Count 4
Instance Size 3x large 8 gb
Instance Idle Timeout 5 min

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Varying loading time
parts:
When applications are not in use (have no connections), they go to sleep. The next time someone visits them, they will automatically be woken up (thats what is happening when you see "Please Wait").

You can adjust how long an idle application will wait before going to sleep by setting the "Instance Idle Timeout". Keep in mind, increasing this means you will consume active hours even when nobody is using your application. Any time the application is not sleeping is considered an active hour.

-Andy
